act_title: The Preference Shares (Regulation of Dividends) Act, 1960
title: Act not to apply to participating preference dividends
text:
6. Act not to apply to participating preference dividends.—Nothing contained in [section 3 or

section 4] shall apply to such part of any dividend on preference shares as is referred to in clause (i) of the
_Explanation to sub-section (1) of section 85 of the Companies Act._
